text.en:
Section one of Act Numbered Sixty-nine is hereby amended by substituting the name of Louis M.
Maus, Major and Surgeon in the United States Army, for that of Charles E. Green-leaf, M. D., Colonel and
Chief Surgeon of the Division of the Philippines, in the United States Army.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, March 4, 1901.
